#

1260H / NS-CMIC lists

US lists of "Chinese military companies": the Defense Department's 1260H list (NDAA FY2021 §1260H) and Treasury's NS-CMIC list. §805 of NDAA FY2024 bans DoD contracting with 1260H firms from 30 Jun 2026 and buying their products from 30 Jun 2027.

Defined in: C06C07merged ×2

144A

A private bond placement sold only to qualified institutional buyers.

Defined in: W02

The "$600B question"

Sequoia's 2024 test of how much end-customer revenue AI needs to justify GPU spending. The Atlas update (W11) puts it at ~$1.6T on Sequoia's method and ~$600B a year on a depreciation basis.

Defined in: W00

800 V DC (HVDC)

NVIDIA-led architecture distributing high-voltage DC to racks from 2027.

In China China's data centers already use HVDC distribution widely at 240 V or 336 V; 800 V is the next step.

Defined in: W04C04merged ×2

8-inch equivalent (8"-eq) wafer

SMIC's capacity unit. One 12-inch wafer ≈ 2.25 8-inch wafers.

Defined in: C06

A

A16 / A14

TSMC's 1.6nm-class and 1.4nm-class nodes (A = ångström).

Defined in: W06

A2A (Agent2Agent)

Google-originated protocol for agents to communicate with each other.

Defined in: W10

ABF (Ajinomoto Build-up Film)

Insulating film used to build the fine-wiring layers of chip package substrates.

Defined in: W06

ABS / CMBS / SASB

Asset-backed securities / commercial mortgage-backed securities / single-asset single-borrower CMBS: bonds repaid from pooled lease payments, such as data-center rents. They let developers refinance stabilized buildings at bond-market rates.

Defined in: W02W04merged ×2

Absorption (net)

Change in occupied or committed capacity over a period. CBRE measures leased colo in primary markets. JLL includes self-build and frontier markets.

Defined in: W04

Accelerator

Any chip specialized for AI math (GPU, TPU, NPU, LPU, XPU).

Defined in: W05

ACIE

NVIDIA's reporting sub-market "AI Clouds, Industrial & Enterprise" (from FY27): its non-hyperscale data-center customers, such as neoclouds, sovereign projects, labs and enterprises.

Defined in: W05W07merged ×2

ACV (annual contract value)

Yearly value of a signed contract; ServiceNow reports AI ACV.

Defined in: W10

Advanced packaging

Joining several dies (logic, memory) in one package with very dense interconnects (2.5D side by side, 3D stacked).

Defined in: W06

AEC (active electrical cable)

Copper cable with retimer/DSP chips in the connectors; reaches ~5–7 m at 100–200G/lane.

Defined in: W07

Aeroderivative

A jet-engine-derived gas turbine (e.g. LM2500/LM6000). Fast to deploy, less efficient, used on-site.

Defined in: W03

Affiliates Rule

BIS 2025 rule extending EL restrictions to ≥50%-owned subsidiaries. Suspended to Nov 9, 2026.

Defined in: C06

Agent

An AI system that is given a goal and pursues it over many steps on its own: it plans, calls tools (browser, terminal, APIs) and iterates with little human input (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor's agent). An agent task uses roughly 4–15× more tokens than a chat.

Defined in: W00W09W10merged ×3

Agentic Work Unit (AWU)

Salesforce's usage metric for agent actions (3.2B in Q2 FY27).

Defined in: W10

AGI clause

A contract term (Microsoft–OpenAI) that changes rights and revenue share once "artificial general intelligence" is declared and verified by an expert panel.

Defined in: W09

"AI+" action (人工智能+)

State Council policy (Aug 2025) to integrate AI into six domains, with penetration targets for 2027/2030/2035.

Defined in: C10

AI办事 ("AI that does things")

Alibaba's framing for agents that complete tasks (ordering, booking, government services) rather than chat.

Defined in: C10

AI build-out

The global investment program in data centers, chips, networking and power to train and run AI models.

Defined in: W00

AI capex (China track)

AI-related DC spending by platforms, carriers, local/SOE centres and labs, incl. ~RMB 110bn of general-purpose kit.

Defined in: C00

AI factory

NVIDIA's term for a data center built mainly to produce tokens (training or inference).

Defined in: W04

AI-attributable

The share of a multi-business company's revenue or profit caused by AI demand.

Defined in: W11

AIDC

"AI data centre", carriers' and landlords' term for AI-grade halls.

Defined in: C00

AI-induced shortage rent

Profit earned from non-AI buyers because AI demand created the shortage (e.g. PC and phone DRAM in 2026).

In China China's CXMT earns it too, selling DRAM to non-AI buyers.

Defined in: W11C11merged ×2

AI-native app (AI原生App)

QuestMobile's category for standalone AI apps (Doubao, Qwen, DeepSeek), as opposed to AI features inside other apps.

Defined in: C10

AI-related product revenue

Alibaba's disclosed revenue from AI compute, MaaS and AI services. It has grown at triple digits for 12 straight quarters.

Defined in: C08

Alibaba Cloud Intelligence Group / AI Cloud and Compute Services

Alibaba's cloud segment, renamed from the Jun-2026 quarter after T-Head (chips) was folded in.

Defined in: C08

ALink / AL128 / UPN512

Alibaba's accelerator interconnect protocol; its 128-accelerator Panjiu supernode; its 512-xPU all-optical scale-up network.

Defined in: C07

All-platform MAU (全端月活)

A company's own count across app, web, PC and embedded surfaces. Always above QuestMobile's app-only count.

Defined in: C10

Announcement No. 46 / No. 18 / Nos. 55–62

MOFCOM export-control announcements on Ga/Ge/Sb (Dec 2024), seven rare earths (Apr 2025) and the Oct-2025 package.

Defined in: C06

ARR / run-rate

Annual recurring revenue: the latest month's revenue × 12 (or week × 52, quarter × 4). For usage-based AI businesses it is not contracted revenue, it overstates calendar-year revenue when growth is fast, and it can fall as quickly as it rose.

Defined in: W00W08W09W10W11merged ×5

Ascend (昇腾, Shēngténg)

Huawei's AI accelerator (NPU) family: 910B, 910C, 950PR/DT, 960, 970 and 980.

Defined in: C00C05merged ×2

Ascend partner OEM

A company (often provincial state-backed) that builds servers around Huawei Ascend modules (e.g., Huakun Zhenyu).

Defined in: C07

ASIC / XPU

Application-specific integrated circuit: a custom AI accelerator designed for one customer's workloads, such as Google's TPU, Amazon's Trainium or Meta's MTIA. Broadcom calls these chips "XPUs".

In China Each big platform has its own: Alibaba T-Head's Zhenwu (真武), Baidu's Kunlunxin (昆仑芯) and ByteDance's SeedChip.

Defined in: W00W05W07C00merged ×4

ASP

Average selling price.

Defined in: W05

ATC (around-the-clock)

A flat 24/7 power block, the typical hyperscaler "firm" product.

Defined in: W03

ATE

Automated test equipment (Advantest, Teradyne).

Defined in: W06

Atlas 950 / 960 / 960E SuperPoD

Huawei's next-gen SuperPoDs (8,192 / 15,488 / 4,096 NPUs); 960E uses NPO.

Defined in: C07

ATM (at-the-market) offering

Selling new shares gradually into the market at prevailing prices through brokers, rather than in one large deal.

Defined in: W01W02merged ×2

AVAP

A sales model Enflame uses with Tencent that bundles chips with services (per its prospectus; conf: med).

Defined in: C05

B

Backside power (Super Power Rail, PowerVia)

Routing power through the back of the wafer, freeing the front for signals.

Defined in: W06

Backstop

A promise to buy unused capacity (e.g. Nvidia's $6.3B CoreWeave backstop).

Defined in: W02

Bailian (百炼) / Model Studio

Alibaba Cloud's MaaS platform. Ark (方舟) is Volcano's; Qianfan (千帆) is Baidu's.

Defined in: C08

Base die

The bottom die of an HBM stack; since HBM4 it is made on a logic process (often by TSMC).

Defined in: W06

Base model

The output of pre-training, before instruction tuning.

Defined in: W09

BBU

Battery backup unit in the rack.

Defined in: W07

BDC

Business development company. A US vehicle, often sold to retail investors, that makes private loans.

Defined in: W02

BESS

Battery energy storage system.

Defined in: W03

BF16 / FP8 / FP4 / NVFP4 / MXFP4

Number formats with 16, 8 or 4 bits. NVFP4 is NVIDIA's 4-bit format with fine-grained scaling. MXFP4 is the OCP-standard equivalent.

Defined in: W05

Big Five (五大发电)

Huaneng, Datang, Huadian, CHN Energy (Guodian), SPIC.

Defined in: C03

Big Fund (大基金, dà jījīn)

The National Integrated Circuit Industry Investment Fund (国家集成电路产业投资基金): Phase I (2014), Phase II (2019) and Phase III (2024). Phase III has RMB 344bn, with the six big state banks as shareholders.

Defined in: C00C02C06C11merged ×4

Big-4 platforms

Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance, Baidu; the "listed three" excludes private ByteDance.

Defined in: C00

Book-to-bill

Orders received ÷ revenue billed in the same period. Above 1 means the backlog is growing.

Defined in: W04

BRA (Base Residual Auction)

PJM's main capacity auction, held ~3 years (lately less) before the delivery year.

Defined in: W03

Bridge loan

A short-term loan (e.g. 1 year) to be refinanced later with bonds or asset sales.

Defined in: W02

BTM (behind-the-meter)

Generation on the customer's side of the utility meter, such as on-site gas turbines or fuel cells, rather than power taken from the grid. It avoids some grid charges and queues; FERC is now restricting "netting" of such load.

Defined in: W00W03merged ×2

Busway

Overhead copper or aluminum bars carrying power to racks, replacing cable.

Defined in: W04

BYOG

"bring your own generation". A large load arrives with new supply to avoid burdening the grid.

Defined in: W03

BYOH (bring your own hardware)

The customer buys the GPUs and the cloud operates them (Oracle).

Defined in: W01

C

CAC / MIIT / NDRC / NDA

Cyberspace Administration of China; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology; National Development and Reform Commission; National Data Administration.

Defined in: C01

CAC filing (网信办备案) / registration (登记)

The Cyberspace Administration of China's security assessment and national filing (备案) that every public generative-AI service needs (988 by 30 Jun 2026). Apps that call a filed model register (登记) with their province.

Defined in: C00C09merged ×2

CANN

Compute Architecture for Neural Networks, Huawei's CUDA equivalent (open-sourced).

Defined in: C05

Cap rate

Stabilized NOI ÷ asset value; a lower cap rate means a higher valuation.

Defined in: W04

Capacity factor / load factor

Actual output (or consumption) ÷ maximum possible over a period.

Defined in: W03

Capacity market

An auction (in PJM, the Base Residual Auction) in which utilities pay power plants, in $/MW-day, to be available to generate or curtail at peak times. It is paid separately from energy ($/MWh). AI load has driven PJM's price up more than 11×.

Defined in: W00W03merged ×2

Capacity price (容量电价)

Regulated fixed payments to coal plants for availability (since 2024).

Defined in: C03

Capex (capital expenditure)

Spending on long-lasting assets such as servers and buildings. It is recorded as an asset and depreciated over the years the asset is used, rather than expensed at once.

In China Chinese platforms report capex on a cash basis. Tencent's "operating capex" covers servers and data centers and excludes office buildings and land.

Defined in: W00W01C01merged ×3

Capex per EFLOPS

All-in data-centre capex divided by dense FP16 compute delivered; the measure on which China is dearer (§5.4).

Defined in: X00

Capital recovery factor (CRF)

The annual payment that repays an asset and earns a required return over its life; used in §5.4 to compare cost of ownership.

Defined in: X00

Card-hour (卡时) / card-hour utilization

One accelerator rented for one hour, China's rental price unit. Card-hour utilization is accelerator hours used ÷ hours available: 36.8% in 2025.

Defined in: C00C08merged ×2

Cash capex / purchases of PP&E

Capex actually paid in cash in the period.

Defined in: W01

CCGT

Combined-cycle gas turbine. A gas turbine plus a steam turbine using waste heat; ~60%+ efficient; the grid's baseload gas workhorse.

Defined in: W03

CCID (赛迪顾问)

MIIT-affiliated research firm.

Defined in: C07

CDS (credit default swap)

Insurance against a borrower's default. Its price, a spread in basis points a year, is a live gauge of how risky the market thinks the borrower is.

Defined in: W02W08merged ×2

CDU (coolant distribution unit)

The pump and heat exchanger that link a rack's liquid-cooling loop to the facility water loop. A core piece of liquid cooling.

Defined in: W04W07merged ×2

Chip-backed SPV

A special-purpose vehicle that buys accelerators and leases them to a lab, with debt secured on the chips and the lease (e.g. Anthropic's ~$35B Apollo/Blackstone SPV, where Broadcom guarantees the chips' residual value).

Defined in: W02

CHIPS Act

The 2022 US law with US$39 bn of manufacturing incentives and a 25% (now 35%) investment tax credit.

Defined in: W06

Circular (vendor) financing

A supplier invests in, lends to, or guarantees a customer, and the customer spends that money buying from the supplier (Nvidia → OpenAI, AMD → Anthropic, Amazon → Anthropic). It supports demand but ties the supplier's revenue to the customer's ability to raise money.

Defined in: W00W02W08W09W11merged ×5

Clos / fat tree

Multi-tier switch topology that gives any-to-any bandwidth.

Defined in: W07

CloudMatrix 384 / Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD

Huawei's all-optical scale-up system of 384 Ascend 910C NPUs acting as one computer over UnifiedBus. Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD is the product name; CloudMatrix 384 is the cloud-service name, sold as Ascend Cloud capacity and as a token service.

Defined in: C05C07C08merged ×3

ClusterMAX

SemiAnalysis's rating of GPU clouds (Platinum → Bronze).

Defined in: W08

CMR (customer management revenue)

Alibaba's advertising and commission revenue from Taobao/Tmall merchants.

Defined in: C10

Coal benchmark price (燃煤发电基准价)

The provincial anchor price for coal power (RMB 0.25–0.453/kWh), around which market prices float.

Defined in: C03

Coding plan

A flat monthly subscription that bundles a quota of model calls for coding agents, sold by Chinese clouds and labs (Volcano, Bailian, Zhipu).

Defined in: C09C10merged ×2

COINS Act

Comprehensive Outbound Investment National Security Act, in the FY2026 NDAA; codifies and expands OISP.

Defined in: C02

Co-location

A data center physically sited at a power plant, taking power directly.

Defined in: W03

Colocation / wholesale lease

Renting space and power in someone else's data center, priced per kW per month.

Defined in: W00

Compute leasing (算力租赁, suànlì zūlìn)

Renting GPU or NPU servers by the card-hour or the server-month, often on 1–5 year contracts.

Defined in: C00C04C08merged ×3

Compute prepayment

Cash paid to suppliers before hardware is delivered; it becomes capex on delivery. Tencent paid ~RMB 51bn in Q2-2026.

Defined in: C01

Compute voucher (算力券, suànlì quàn) / token voucher (词元券, cíyuán quàn)

Local-government subsidies that pay part of an SME's compute-rental or token bill, often 30–50%. Some cities also issue model vouchers (模型券).

Defined in: C00C02C04C08C10C11merged ×6

Compute–power coordination (算电协同, suàn-diàn xiétóng)

Co-planning and co-dispatch of compute and electricity: siting and scheduling AI load where and when renewable power would otherwise be curtailed. Named in the 2026 Government Work Report and the 15th Five-Year Plan, and paired with green-power direct connection (绿电直连).

Defined in: C00C03C11merged ×3

Computer use

A model operating a graphical interface (screenshots, clicks, typing).

Defined in: W10

Containment / resolution rate

Share of customer conversations an agent completes without a human.

Defined in: W10

Context window

The amount of text (tokens) a model can consider at once. Agents re-send it every step.

Defined in: W10

Contra revenue

Incentives paid to customers booked as a reduction of revenue (Alibaba's "business development program").

Defined in: C10

Contracted power (neocloud)

MW or GW of data-center capacity a GPU cloud has secured under signed leases or ownership, whether or not it is yet energized ("active power"). CoreWeave reports both.

Defined in: W04

Contracted vs active power

MW signed under lease vs MW energized and hosting billing GPUs.

Defined in: W08

Convertible note

A bond that can convert into shares. It has a low coupon because it includes an equity option.

Defined in: W02

Copilot

An AI assistant embedded in an existing workflow that suggests while a human decides (GitHub Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot). The step before an agent.

Defined in: W00W10merged ×2

CoPoS

Chip-on-Panel-on-Substrate, TSMC's panel-based successor to CoWoS.

Defined in: W06

Cornerstone investor

An IPO anchor that commits before pricing and accepts a lock-up (usually 6 months in HK).

Defined in: C02

Cost of revenue (CoR) / COGS

For labs, mainly inference compute plus hosting, revenue share and payment fees.

Defined in: W09

CoWoS (-S / -L / -R)

Chip-on-Wafer-on-Substrate: TSMC's 2.5D advanced packaging, which places GPU logic dies and HBM side by side on a silicon interposer (-S), local silicon bridges (-L, for larger multi-die packages) or a redistribution-layer interposer (-R). It was the key bottleneck in 2023–24.

Defined in: W00W05W06merged ×3

CPO / NPO / LPO

Co-packaged optics (inside the ASIC package) / near-packaged optics (optical engines next to the switch or NPU package on the board) / linear pluggable optics (pluggable modules without a DSP). NPO sits between pluggables and CPO; Huawei's Atlas 960E uses it.

Defined in: C05C07merged ×2

CPO (co-packaged optics)

Optical engines in the same package as the switch/processor ASIC.

Defined in: W07

C-REIT

China's public infrastructure REIT (基础设施公募REITs). Data centers became eligible in 2025.

Defined in: C04

Critical IT load (MW IT)

Megawatts available to IT equipment, excluding cooling overhead. Gross (utility) MW is higher by the PUE and redundancy overhead.

Defined in: W04W08merged ×2

CSP

Cloud service provider (a hyperscaler).

Defined in: W06

CUDA

NVIDIA's programming platform for its GPUs (2006), and the core of its software moat.

Defined in: W05

CW laser

Continuous-wave laser, used with silicon-photonic modulators.

Defined in: W07

CW laser / EML

Continuous-wave laser used with silicon photonics / electro-absorption modulated laser.

Defined in: C07

D

D&A

Depreciation (tangible assets) and amortisation (intangibles), non-cash expenses.

Defined in: W01

Data center

A building housing computers, with its own electrical, cooling and network infrastructure.

Defined in: W00

DAU cost (单个日活成本)

Subsidy spending divided by incremental daily active users; ¥69–144 in Spring Festival 2026.

Defined in: C10

DCI

Data-center interconnect (links between sites).

Defined in: W07

DCU

Hygon's "deep computing unit", a GPGPU.

Defined in: C05

DDTL (delayed-draw term loan)

A loan drawn in stages as the assets it finances (GPUs) are delivered, secured by those GPUs and the customer contracts they serve. CoreWeave's main funding tool.

Defined in: W02W08merged ×2

Decode / prefill

The two phases of LLM inference: token generation (memory-bound) and prompt processing (compute-bound).

Defined in: W05

Dense vs sparse FLOPS

Sparse ratings assume 2:4 structured sparsity and are 2× dense.

Defined in: W05

Depreciation / useful life

Spreading an asset's cost over the years it is used. Servers are depreciated over about 5–6 years and buildings over 15–25. The useful life is the central accounting judgement for GPU fleets: longer lives mean lower annual depreciation and higher reported profit today.

Defined in: W00W01W08merged ×3

Depreciation wall

The rising annual depreciation charge that follows a capex surge, as short-lived IT assets enter service.

Defined in: W11

Depreciation-based requirement

The revenue needed for capex to earn its cost of capital: depreciation + opex + return, grossed up for downstream margins.

Defined in: W11

Die bank

A stockpile of chip dies fabricated before a control took effect (2.9m Ascend dies from TSMC).

Defined in: C05

Dim-sum bond

An offshore RMB-denominated bond issued in Hong Kong.

Defined in: C02

Direct-to-chip (DLC)

Liquid-cooled cold plates on processors.

Defined in: W04

Disaggregated inference

Running prefill and decode on different hardware pools.

Defined in: W05

Distillation

Training a smaller or cheaper model on the outputs of a stronger model.

In China It is contested when done through a rival's API in breach of its terms.

Defined in: W09C09merged ×2

Domestic AI accelerators (Ascend, Zhenwu, Kunlun, MLU)

Leading domestic AI accelerators (C05).

Defined in: C01

Domestic substitution (国产替代, guóchǎn tìdài)

Replacing foreign components with Chinese ones.

Defined in: C00

DPU / SuperNIC

Smart network card (BlueField, ConnectX-8/9).

Defined in: W07

DRAM / NAND

The two main memory types: DRAM (working memory) and NAND (flash storage, SSDs).

Defined in: W00

Dry cooler / air-cooled chiller

Rejects heat to outside air without evaporating water.

Defined in: W04

DSCR (debt-service coverage ratio)

Cash available for debt service ÷ required payments. 1.12× means 12% headroom.

Defined in: W02

DSO

Days sales outstanding, how long customers take to pay.

Defined in: W05

DSP (in optics)

Chip that cleans and encodes the high-speed signal (PAM4) inside a transceiver.

In China Marvell and Broadcom dominate the DSPs inside Chinese optical modules too.

Defined in: W07C07merged ×2

Dual control of energy and carbon (能耗双控 / 碳双控)

Dual control of energy consumption (total and intensity), shifting to dual control of carbon.

Defined in: C03

DUVi (ArF immersion)

193nm lithography with water between lens and wafer (ASML NXT:1980i/2000i). China's most advanced installed litho.

Defined in: C06

E

East Data, West Compute (东数西算, Dōng shù xī suàn)

The 2022 national program that steers large data centers into 8 hub nodes and 10 clusters (Inner Mongolia, Ningxia, Gansu, Guizhou, Chengdu–Chongqing, Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei, the Yangtze River Delta and Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macau) and routes eastern workloads to cheap western power.

Defined in: C00C01C03C04C08C11merged ×6

ECI

Epoch Capabilities Index. AA index: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. LMArena: a human-preference Elo leaderboard.

Defined in: C09

EDA

Electronic design automation, the software used to design chips.

Defined in: W06

EFLOPS / PFLOPS (FP16)

10^18 / 10^15 floating-point operations per second. MIIT reports national "intelligent compute" in EFLOPS, usually at FP16, though Chinese statistics mix FP16 and FP32.

Defined in: C00C01C04merged ×3

EFLOPS per GW (compute density)

Dense FP16 exaFLOPS installed per GW of facility power; ~1,250 for Blackwell-class, ~280–420 for Ascend-class.

Defined in: X00

ELCC

Effective load-carrying capability. How much a resource counts toward reliability (e.g. solar counts little at winter peaks).

Defined in: W03

Elo (LMArena)

A relative-preference rating derived from head-to-head human votes.

Defined in: W09

EMIB / EMIB-T

Intel's Embedded Multi-die Interconnect Bridge: small silicon bridges buried in the package substrate that link dies. EMIB-T adds through-silicon vias and is Intel's alternative to CoWoS.

Defined in: W05W06merged ×2

EML

Electro-absorption modulated laser; the classic 100G/200G-per-lane laser, made on InP.

Defined in: W07

End-customer AI money

Consumer, enterprise and advertiser spending on AI products, AI infrastructure services and AI-driven ads, net of intermediate purchases (e.g. an app buying API tokens).

Defined in: W11

Energy-consumption quota (能耗指标)

The provincial approval needed for projects that use more than about 10,000 tonnes of coal equivalent a year (about 10 MW). It gates new large loads and is the real constraint on data centers in the east.

Defined in: C00C04C11merged ×3

Entity List (EL)

BIS list requiring licenses (usually denied) for US-origin items.

Defined in: C06

Equity-for-purchase

An investor's equity stake paired with a commitment to buy the investee's product (Kunlunxin cornerstones; AMD warrants to OpenAI and Meta run the other way).

Defined in: X00

ERCOT

The Texas grid operator (mostly outside FERC jurisdiction). Batch Zero: its 2026 cluster-study process for large loads.

Defined in: W03

ESA

Electric service agreement between a utility and a customer.

Defined in: W03

ESUN

Ethernet for Scale-Up Networking (OCP workstream led by Meta and Microsoft).

Defined in: W07

ETH-X

ODCC/Tencent-led Ethernet-based scale-up specification.

Defined in: C07

EUV / DUV / High-NA EUV

Lithography generations. Deep-UV (193nm) prints older layers; extreme-UV (13.5nm) prints the finest features; High-NA EUV uses a 0.55 numerical aperture for finer still. ASML is the only maker of EUV machines.

Defined in: W00W06merged ×2

EUV / LPP / LDP

Extreme-ultraviolet (13.5nm) lithography. The light comes from a laser-produced plasma (ASML's LPP) or a laser-induced discharge plasma (LDP, Huawei's reported approach).

Defined in: C06

Exaflop (EF)

10¹⁸ FLOPS.

Defined in: W05

F

FCC equipment authorization

US approval required before RF/electronic devices are marketed; the draft would withhold it from new Chinese optical-module models.

Extra yield over Treasuries. 100bp = 1 percentage point.

SPV / JV

Special-purpose vehicle / joint venture: a separate legal entity that owns an asset such as a data center and holds its debt, keeping it off the tenant's balance sheet (e.g. Meta–Blue Owl's Hyperion).

Defined in: W00W01W02merged ×3

Standard rack (标准机架)

A statistical unit normalized to 2.5 kW, so a 25 kW AI rack = 10 standard racks.

Defined in: C04

STAR Market (科创板)

Shanghai's Science and Technology Innovation Board. Its "fifth set of standards" lets loss-making hard-tech companies list; with HKEX Chapter 18C it carried the 2025–26 wave of chip and lab IPOs.

Defined in: C00C02C05merged ×3

Stargate

OpenAI's multi-partner data-center program (Oracle, SoftBank, MGX, Crusoe, and others).

Defined in: W08

State-directed vs state-shaped capex

State-directed = spent by carriers, SOEs and local-government centres (~19%); state-shaped = any capex whose chip mix is set by procurement mandates or NDRC approvals (~89%).

Defined in: X00

Stockpiling cycle

Pull-forward of chip purchases ahead of an expected export-control change, followed by a pause.

Defined in: C01

Strict vs broad circularity

Strict counts compute and chip suppliers only; broad adds strategic partners (SoftBank/Stargate) and component makers (memory).

Defined in: W11X00merged ×2

SUE

Broadcom's Scale-Up Ethernet framework.

Defined in: W07

Super-entry (超级入口, chāojí rùkǒu)

The default interface through which users reach services and commerce: the prize that Doubao, Qwen and WeChat are fighting over in the assistant war.

Defined in: C00C10merged ×2

Supernode / SuperPoD (超节点, chāo jiédiǎn)

A scale-up domain larger than one server: hundreds to thousands of accelerators joined by memory-semantic links so they act as one machine, such as Huawei's CloudMatrix 384 and Atlas 950/960E, which span many racks.

Defined in: C00C04C07C11merged ×4

Superpod

Google's maximum TPU pod (9,216 Ironwood chips).

Defined in: W05

Switchgear

Breakers and switches that route and protect MV/LV power.

Defined in: W04

T

Take-or-pay

A contract under which the buyer pays for committed capacity (power, rack space, GPUs) whether or not it uses it. In colocation, 60–85% minimum-utilization floors are now appearing.

In China Such contracts are rare in China.

Defined in: W00W01W03W04W08W09W11C08merged ×8

TC bonder

Thermo-compression bonder that stacks HBM dies with micro-bumps.

Defined in: W06

TCO

Total cost of ownership (chip + power + facility + networking + software + people over the asset's life).

Defined in: W05

TDP

Thermal design power, the chip's rated power draw.

Defined in: W05

Ten-thousand-card cluster (万卡集群, wàn kǎ jíqún)

A training cluster of 10,000 or more accelerators. China had 52 by mid-2026.

Defined in: C00C01C11merged ×3

T-Head / Zhenwu (真武)

Alibaba's chip unit and its AI accelerator (PPU) line.

Defined in: C08

Time horizon (METR)

The length of task, measured in expert-human time, that a model completes with 50% (or 80%) reliability. It has been doubling about every seven months.

Defined in: W09W10merged ×2

TLB (term loan B)

Institutional, syndicated loan; Lambda's was rated investment-grade (Baa2).

Defined in: W08

Token

A chunk of text (about ¾ of an English word) or other data. It is the unit in which models read and write, and in which AI usage is priced ($ per million tokens).

In China The official Chinese term is 词元 (cíyuán), adopted by the National Data Administration in March 2026; it now publishes national token volumes (词元调用量). Chinese prices are quoted in RMB per million tokens.

Defined in: W00W01W09W10C00C01C08C10merged ×8

TPP

Total Processing Performance (TOPS × bit-width), the US export-control metric.

Defined in: C05

TPU / Trainium

Google's and Amazon's custom AI accelerators.

Defined in: W09

Trade-in subsidy (以旧换新 / 国补)

National consumer subsidy program; in 2026 it covers phones, tablets, watches and smart glasses at 15% up to ¥500.

Defined in: C10

Training vs inference

Training builds a model (a one-time, huge compute job); inference runs the trained model to answer requests (continuous, and growing with usage).

Defined in: W00W01W09merged ×3

Triple-net (NNN) lease

A lease in which the tenant pays power, taxes, insurance and maintenance on top of base rent.

Defined in: W02W04merged ×2

Truce expiries

The US Affiliates Rule suspension (to 9 Nov 2026) and China's pause of rare-earth/Ga/Ge controls (to 10 Nov 2026).

Defined in: X00

TSV

Through-silicon via, a vertical copper connection through a die.

Defined in: W06

U

UALink

An open, memory-semantic scale-up interconnect standard for accelerators, backed by AMD and others as an alternative to NVLink.

Defined in: W05W07merged ×2

UE8M0 FP8

DeepSeek's FP8 scaling format (8-bit exponent, 0-bit mantissa scale factors), chosen for domestic chips.

Defined in: C05

UEC / UET

Ultra Ethernet Consortium / its transport protocol.

Defined in: W07

UHV (特高压)

Ultra-high voltage, ±800/±1,100 kV DC and 1,000 kV AC lines.

Defined in: C03

UnifiedBus (UB, 灵衢, Língqú)

Huawei's scale-up and scale-out interconnect protocol for supernodes and clusters (UB 2.0; UBoE runs it over Ethernet). Huawei opened the specification in 2025.

Defined in: C00C05C07merged ×3

Uprate

Increasing an existing reactor's licensed output.

Defined in: W03

UPS

Uninterruptible power supply. Batteries plus power electronics bridging outages.

Defined in: W04

V

VCSEL

Vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (cheap, short-reach).

Defined in: W07

VEU (Validated End-User)

US status that let Samsung, SK hynix and TSMC China fabs receive tools without individual licenses. Revoked effective end-2025.

Defined in: C06

Vibe coding

Building software by describing it in natural language to an agent (Lovable, Replit, Bolt, v0).

Defined in: W10

W

Warrant

A right to buy shares at a set price. AMD granted OpenAI and Meta warrants for up to 160m shares each at $0.01, vesting on deployment and share-price milestones.

Defined in: W02W05merged ×2

West / China (X00 definition)

West = every non-China buyer and supplier, including Taiwan, Korea, Japan and the Gulf; China = mainland-domiciled companies plus Hong Kong, including capacity they own or rent offshore (§1.1).

Defined in: X00

WFE

Wafer-fab equipment (front-end tools).

Defined in: W06

White box

Switch hardware from an ODM running the buyer's own software.

Defined in: W07

Wholesale vs retail

Wholesale = MW-scale leases to hyperscalers (per kW, often power-exclusive); retail = per-cabinet leases to enterprises (power and bandwidth included).

Defined in: C04

wpm

Wafers per month (capacity unit).

In China The China dossiers also use wspm, wafer starts per month.

Defined in: W06C06merged ×2

Wrapper

An app that adds a thin UI on top of a third-party model, with little proprietary value.

Defined in: W10

X

XDFOI

JCET's 2.5D/3D fan-out chiplet packaging platform.

Defined in: C06

Xiaowei (小微)

The WeChat AI agent Tencent is testing (2026).

Defined in: C10

Xinchuang (信创, xìnchuàng)

"IT application innovation": the state program that mandates domestic CPUs, operating systems, servers and software in government and SOEs. A captive market for Hygon and Huawei's Kunpeng.

Defined in: C00C05C07C08C11merged ×5

xScale

Equinix's hyperscale JV platform.

Defined in: W04

Xtacking

YMTC's architecture that bonds a separately made CMOS logic wafer to the memory-array wafer.

Defined in: C06

Y

Yield

The share of good dies per wafer.

Defined in: W06

Yield on cost

Stabilized NOI ÷ total development cost.

Defined in: W04

Yi-Zhong-Tian (易中天)

Market nickname for Eoptolink (易), InnoLight (中) and TFC (天).

Defined in: C07

Z

ZEC

Zero-emission credit, a state subsidy keeping nuclear plants open (e.g. Illinois, to mid-2027).

Defined in: W03
